editorial:
Imagine spending your summer in the sunny hills of Mallorca, trying to forget about a sickness that keeps you trapped in a hospital. That is exactly what Ry does. You get to follow her as she leaves her stressful college life behind to hang out with her mom in Spain. The vibe is super relaxing at first, especially when she meets a local guy who teaches her how to actually enjoy life instead of just surviving it. It feels like a warm hug, but you can tell there is something heavy hiding under the surface that is about to pop up.

The acting is the best part here because the chemistry between the two leads feels totally real. While the middle part slows down a bit, the family secrets that come out later keep you glued to your seat. If you love a good cry and a beautiful setting, you need to see this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see those gorgeous Spanish views, or just rent it on Apple TV for a cozy movie night. It is the kind of film that looks amazing on a big screen.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Ry finds out her mother has been hiding a cure that was available all along, but her mother feared the side effects. Ry decides to take the risk anyway. The movie ends with her recovering and watching the sunrise with her boyfriend. It shows that while life is short, taking a chance on yourself is always worth it. They stay together and start a new life in Spain.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves emotional romances and beautiful scenery.
